item.text: {"items":[{"id":"k1","verdict":"taught","note":"Sustained high estradiol from the dominant follicle switches pituitary feedback to positive, triggering the LH surge."},{"id":"k2","verdict":"taught","note":"The corpus luteum produces progesterone for about 14 days unless hCG rescues it, making luteal phase length relatively fixed."},{"id":"k3","verdict":"missing","note":"The text does not address the sites or timing of oocyte arrest in meiosis."}]}
